interpretation: Targets are distinct interaction/state audit items, not 109 reusable component definitions. Native/static items are intentional dispositions, not missing animation.

press.behavior: Scale 1 → .97 → 1; icon targets keep their 48px hit area.

icon.behavior: Crossfade icon states; do not animate password characters or provider logos.

tooltip.behavior: Opacity and 4px approach after deliberate hover/focus; Escape dismisses.
tooltip.reduced: Immediate tooltip after the same intent delay.

menu.behavior: Open from the trigger; focus and arrow keys stay usable before animation ends.

tabs.behavior: Underline follows the selected target; content fade only, no lateral text sweep.
tabs.reduced: Underline and selected state update immediately.

field.behavior: Border/tint respond to focus; label, value and cursor remain stable.
field.reduced: Immediate focus border and static ring.

validation.behavior: Inline error and icon appear; reserve local space, keep focus and input.

check.behavior: Check path draws once after the actual local/committed selection change.

feedback.behavior: Short result transition; never infer success from animation duration.

busy.behavior: Stable-width action; activity only while truly pending, cancellable immediately.

node.behavior: Opacity + 8px approach; reflow only affected peers and never replay on polling.

selection.behavior: Selected node 64→96px (mobile 56→80); others settle at .13 opacity.

badge.behavior: Small overlaid icon crossfade; no repeated pulse or status paragraph.

cloud.behavior: Cloud symbol identifies the actual source/target leg; Stored is distinct from Delivered.
cloud.reduced: Static correct cloud leg and status.

graph.behavior: Keep two nodes and one curve; route changes do not reset acknowledged bytes.

orbit.behavior: At most 24ms offsets, 180ms total; actions never wait for the sequence.

drag.behavior: One eligible halo, slight target scale; handoff retargets without flicker.
drag.reduced: Static halo plus icon; same drop area.

drop.behavior: End system drag image, compress target briefly, then open review; no fake upload.

progress.behavior: Blue tracks confirmed bytes only; numeric values change immediately, never count up.

flow.behavior: One sheen clipped to real blue progress; pause/hidden/offscreen stops it.

receipt.behavior: One check/outline settle only after required proof/commit/receipt; dedupe by event ID.

surface.behavior: Fade and gentle scale from its origin; removal/focus never depend on transitionend.

sheet.behavior: 24px approach; direct manipulation follows the pointer, release keeps velocity.
sheet.reduced: Immediate geometry; native gesture remains usable.

navigation.behavior: Parent-child relationship; Back reverses direction, preserved content does not remount.

list.behavior: Keyed items preserve location/selection; cap initial stagger at 3 items / 48ms.

copy.behavior: Copy → check only after the clipboard promise resolves; failure keeps selectable text.

queue.behavior: Offline intent stays pending; catch-up reconciles grant/epoch before success feedback.

native.behavior: Keep native keyboard, file picker, camera permission, select and install prompt motion.
native.reduced: Let the platform apply its accessibility settings.

static.behavior: Keep text, codes, caret, countdown and language reflow readable; animate only a surrounding control when relevant.
